rationale: Spine lettering and engraved cover inscriptions are rune-like ornament on the material and decoration layer; they carry no UI copy and no narrative text, so the text-free-art product policy does not apply to them.
The exception is limited to this class of baked lettering. Any other structural defect, and any non-lettering defect, still leaves G3 open; nothing else is waived.
The same decision confirms overall approval of the 15 Artifact artworks; only the objects that need the policy exception are registered here.

A02_ALZUHOD_QUILL.note: decorative printing on the background book spines is spine material, not copy

A03_TRUNSOEST_BRASS_BOOK.note: the brass-cover inscription is engraved ornament, not copy
